description: Resolve an ENS name (or onchain subdomain, e.g. etherscan.eth or gm.etherscan.eth) to its Ethereum address. Ethereum mainnet only. Offchain names that require CCIP Read / wildcard resolution (e.g. *.base.eth) are not supported. A name that does not resolve returns ok:true with a null result.

name.description: ENS name to resolve, e.g. 'etherscan.eth' or a subdomain like 'gm.etherscan.eth'.

name: resolve_ens_name

data.description: The JSON result returned by the Etherscan data tool.

title: Resolve Ens Name
